name: Russia–NATO
value: Poland border alert ran to 8 Nov; no Article 4
summary: Poland's Kaliningrad border alert ran to 8 Nov; Latvia reported an airspace intrusion on 3 Nov; no Article 4 request
state: Polish police were ordered to full readiness for 2–8 Nov during an operation on the Kaliningrad border, launched over reported sabotage threats (Notes from Poland); no report on whether it continued after 8 Nov was found. Lithuania's defence minister said on 6 Nov that its border was calmer than Poland's and that extending troop support there was likely (LRT). Latvia's armed forces reported an object entering its airspace on 3 Nov, with origin not established (Defence Matters). Searches on 9 Nov found no Article 4 request or direct clash.
for_you: Border areas in Poland and the Baltic states may see extra police and military presence and short-notice airspace alerts. Local emergency notices and FCDO travel advice are the official guide for residents and visitors.
rubric_hit: Watch: airspace violation (Latvia, 3 Nov) and reported sabotage threats on Poland's Kaliningrad border; no Article 4 consultations or attack on NATO territory

rubric.alert: Article 4 consultations, a direct military clash, or an attack on NATO territory.
rubric.watch: Airspace/drone violations, sabotage attributed to Russia, or explicit threats against members.
rubric.normal: No notable incidents on NATO territory in the past two weeks.
